milestones.label: Hilbert's Problem 2: consistency of arithmetic axioms
milestones.work: Hilbert, D., Mathematische Probleme, Nachrichten von der Gesellschaft der Wissenschaften zu Goettingen, 1900
milestones.description: Hilbert's Paris lecture asks for a proof of the consistency of the arithmetical axioms, the problem the programme later addresses without yet giving a method.

evidence.claim: Mathematische Probleme appears in the Nachrichten Goettingen in 1900, pages 253-297

milestones.note: Precursor: asks the question, gives no finitary method. Sets no derived date.

milestones.label: Hilbert's Heidelberg lecture on the foundations of logic and arithmetic
milestones.work: Hilbert, D., Ueber die Grundlagen der Logik und der Arithmetik, Verhandlungen des Dritten Internationalen Mathematiker-Kongresses, 1905
milestones.description: Hilbert's lecture for the 1904 congress sketches a proof-theoretic route to consistency; this is the earliest public statement of the approach found.

evidence.claim: Lecture published in the Verhandlungen of the Third International Congress in 1905 (given 1904)

milestones.note: Whether this lecture already states the programme (rather than a precursor idea) is not verified against the text; the named programme is the 1922 paper. Conceptual derived date uses this record, so it is provisional.

milestones.label: Hilbert's Neubegruendung der Mathematik
milestones.work: Hilbert, D., Neubegruendung der Mathematik. Erste Mitteilung, Abhandlungen aus dem Mathematischen Seminar der Hamburgischen Universitaet, 1922
milestones.description: Hilbert names and formulates the programme: prove the consistency of mathematics with finitary (intuitive) methods.

evidence.claim: Neubegruendung der Mathematik, Erste Mitteilung, Hamburg Abhandlungen 1922
Wikipedia says Hilbert's programme was formulated in the early 1920s

milestones.label: Godel's incompleteness theorems
milestones.work: Goedel, K., Ueber formal unentscheidbare Saetze der Principia Mathematica und verwandter Systeme I, Monatshefte fuer Mathematik und Physik, 1931
milestones.description: Godel's incompleteness theorems show that most of the programme's goals cannot be reached in their obvious form.

evidence.claim: Paper appears in Monatshefte fuer Mathematik und Physik in 1931
Wikipedia says Godel's incompleteness theorems published in 1931 showed the programme unattainable for key areas

milestones.label: Grundlagen der Mathematik
milestones.work: Hilbert, D. and Bernays, P., Grundlagen der Mathematik, vol. 1, Springer, 1934
milestones.description: The Hilbert-Bernays volumes give the first systematic treatment of the proof theory of the programme.

evidence.claim: Grundlagen der Mathematik published 1934 under Hilbert's name

milestones.note: Open Library lists Hilbert only for the 1934 edition; Bernays as co-author is from general knowledge. Systematic-treatment role not checked against text.

milestones.label: Gentzen's consistency proof of arithmetic
milestones.work: Gentzen, G., Die Widerspruchsfreiheit der reinen Zahlentheorie, Mathematische Annalen, 1936
milestones.description: Gentzen proves the consistency of elementary number theory by transfinite induction, the first purposeful consistency proof for arithmetic in the programme's spirit.

evidence.claim: Paper appears in Mathematische Annalen in 1936
MacTutor quotes Gentzen's aim to prove the consistency of elementary number theory

milestones.note: Whether this counts as finitary is disputed: it uses transfinite induction, so it goes beyond Hilbert's original finitist standard. Classified as first_application for the consistency problem, not for the finitist standard.
